question: Which snack is the HEALTHIEST choice for your body?
explanation: Apples are packed with vitamins and fiber that help your body grow strong and keep you full longer!

question: What is the best drink for your body every day?
explanation: Water keeps you hydrated, helps your brain think clearly, and has ZERO sugar! Drink 6-8 glasses a day!

question: Which of these is a vegetable?
explanation: Broccoli is a super vegetable! It's loaded with vitamins C and K that make your bones and immune system strong!

question: What is WRONG with eating fast food every day?

choices.B: It has too much salt, fat and sugar

explanation: Fast food has lots of salt, fat, and sugar that can make you feel tired and hurt your heart over time. Save it for special treats only!

question: Which breakfast gives you the BEST energy for school?
explanation: Oatmeal with fruit gives you slow, steady energy all morning so your brain can focus and learn! Breakfast is the most important meal!

question: How many colors of fruits and vegetables should you try to eat each day?
explanation: Eating a rainbow of colors means you get different vitamins! Red, orange, yellow, green, blue — each color has special powers for your body!

question: Which is the healthiest way to cook vegetables?
explanation: Steaming or eating vegetables raw keeps all the vitamins inside! Frying destroys many nutrients and adds unhealthy fat.

question: Why is eating fried food too often BAD for you?

choices.B: It clogs your blood vessels with unhealthy fat

explanation: Fried food has unhealthy fat that can clog your arteries (blood pipes) over time. This makes your heart work extra hard — not good!

question: Which food has the MOST protein to help build strong muscles?
explanation: Eggs are packed with protein! Protein is like the building blocks for your muscles. Athletes and growing kids need lots of it!

question: What should you do INSTEAD of eating when you are bored?

choices.C: Go play outside or do a fun activity 🎨

explanation: Bored eating can lead to eating too much junk food! When bored, go play, draw, read, or do something fun. Your body will thank you!

question: How many minutes should kids exercise EVERY day?
explanation: Kids should move their bodies for at least 60 minutes every day! It doesn't have to be all at once — playing, biking, and dancing all count!

question: Which activity is GREAT exercise for your heart?
explanation: Swimming works your WHOLE body and is amazing for your heart! When your heart beats fast during exercise, it gets stronger — like a muscle!

question: What should you ALWAYS do before exercising?
explanation: Warming up and stretching prepares your muscles so they don't get hurt! Think of it like waking your muscles up gently before asking them to work hard.

question: What does regular exercise do for your MOOD?

choices.C: Makes you happier and less stressed 😊

explanation: Exercise releases special chemicals in your brain called endorphins — they're like natural happiness pills! That's why you feel great after playing outside!

question: Why is it important to drink water DURING exercise?

choices.B: Your body loses water through sweat and needs to refill 💧
choices.D: Water is only for after exercise

explanation: When you exercise you sweat — that's your body cooling itself down. You need to drink water to replace what you lost, or you'll feel dizzy and weak!

question: Which is NOT a good exercise habit?

choices.C: Sitting on the couch all day 🛋️

explanation: Sitting for hours is bad for your body! Your muscles get stiff, your energy goes down, and your heart doesn't get the workout it needs. Get moving!

question: How does exercise help your BRAIN at school?

choices.B: It helps you focus and remember things better 🧠
choices.D: It has no effect on the brain

explanation: Exercise sends more blood and oxygen to your brain! Studies show kids who exercise regularly get better grades and can focus longer in class. Wow!

question: What kind of exercise builds STRONG bones?
explanation: Weight-bearing exercises like jumping and running put healthy stress on your bones — this makes them grow thicker and stronger! Your bones are building now!

question: Which sport teaches you teamwork AND exercise?
explanation: Soccer (and most team sports) teach you to work together, communicate, and support your teammates — AND you get great exercise at the same time!

question: How many days a week should kids do some kind of exercise?

choices.D: Only when they feel like it

explanation: Moving your body every single day is the goal! Even a walk with your family, dancing in the kitchen, or helping with yard work counts as great exercise!

question: How many hours of sleep do elementary school kids NEED each night?
explanation: Kids need 9-11 hours of sleep! While you sleep, your brain stores memories from school and your body grows. Sleep is when the magic happens!

question: How long should you wash your hands to kill germs?
explanation: Washing for 20 seconds with soap kills germs that make you sick! Singing Happy Birthday twice helps you time it. Clean hands = healthy you!

question: How often should you brush your teeth?

choices.C: Twice a day — morning and night 🦷

explanation: Brushing twice a day removes germs and food that cause cavities. Healthy teeth let you eat all your healthy foods and smile your biggest smile!

question: What is a GREAT habit to do right after school?

choices.C: Leave homework for the last minute

explanation: Doing homework first means it's done when your brain is still fresh from school! Then you can relax and play without worrying about it. Smart move!

question: What is the KINDEST thing you can do for a friend who is sad?

choices.C: Listen and ask if they're okay 🤗

explanation: Being a good listener is one of the most powerful acts of kindness! Your friend doesn't always need solutions — sometimes they just need to feel heard and loved.

question: What should you do with your belongings after using them?

choices.B: Put them back where they belong 🏠

explanation: Putting things away when you're done keeps your space clean, saves time finding things later, and shows respect for your home and family. Tidy spaces = calm mind!

question: How can you handle feeling angry in a healthy way?

choices.C: Take deep breaths and talk about your feelings 🌬️

explanation: Deep breathing calms your body down! When you breathe slowly, your brain can think clearly again. Then you can use your words to explain how you feel.

question: Why is READING for fun important?

choices.C: It grows your vocabulary and imagination 📖

explanation: Every book you read teaches you new words and new ideas! Kids who read for fun score higher on tests and are more creative. Stories take you anywhere!

question: What is the best thing to do BEFORE bed to sleep well?

choices.C: Put screens away and read or relax 🌙

explanation: Screens (phones, tablets, TV) have blue light that tricks your brain into thinking it's daytime! Turning them off 30 minutes before bed helps you fall asleep faster.

question: Why is it important to say 'please' and 'thank you'?

choices.C: It shows respect and makes people feel valued ✨
choices.D: Only adults need to say it

explanation: Good manners show you respect others and are grateful for their help. People who use kind words make friends more easily and create a happier world around them!

question: If you earn $10 doing chores, how much should you SAVE (30%)?
explanation: 30% of $10 = $3.00! Save $3, and you still have $7 to spend or give. That saved $3 will grow over time into something amazing!

question: What is the DIFFERENCE between a 'need' and a 'want'?

choices.B: Needs are things to survive; wants are extras 🎯

explanation: NEEDS: food, water, shelter, clothing. WANTS: video games, candy, toys. Always pay for needs first! Then save, and use leftover money for wants.

question: You save $5 every week. How much do you have after 4 weeks?
explanation: $5 × 4 weeks = $20! That's the power of saving consistently. Small amounts add up to BIG amounts over time. This is called building savings!

question: What is a PIGGY BANK used for?
explanation: A piggy bank is your first savings account! Every coin or bill you drop in is money FUTURE YOU will get to use. It teaches you to think ahead!

question: Before buying something fun, what is the SMART thing to ask yourself?

choices.B: Will I still want this in a week, or is it just exciting right now? 🤔

explanation: Waiting before buying is called 'sleeping on it.' Often the excitement fades and you realize you didn't really need it. Your money stays in your pocket!

question: What happens to your savings over many years?

choices.C: It GROWS — even in a bank it earns extra money called interest 📈

explanation: Money in a bank earns INTEREST — the bank pays you extra money just for keeping yours there! Over years, this makes your savings grow even without adding more!

question: Which is the SMARTER money choice?

choices.A: Spend all your money the day you get it
choices.B: Buy the most expensive thing always
choices.C: Save 30%, give some, and spend the rest wisely 🌟

explanation: The golden rule: Save 30% first (pay yourself!), give a little to help others, then spend what's left on things you truly need or enjoy. Balance is key!

question: What is a BUDGET?

choices.B: A plan for how to spend and save your money 📋

explanation: A budget is your money plan! It tells your money where to go instead of wondering where it went. Even kids can make a budget with their allowance!

question: Why is it good to give SOME of your money to help others?

choices.A: It isn't — keep all your money
choices.C: Helping others makes the world better AND makes you feel great 💛

explanation: Giving even a little — to a food bank, an animal shelter, or someone in need — creates ripples of kindness. And science shows that giving actually makes YOU happier too!

question: You want a toy that costs $15. You have $8 saved. What should you do?

choices.C: Keep saving until you have $15 — then buy it! 💪

explanation: Saving up for something you want feels AMAZING when you finally buy it! You learn patience, goal-setting, and the true value of money. That toy will feel extra special!
